docs-lead: quick sync — opened a docs PR to relax the schema for tool outputs (nullable vs missing). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5821

sam: saw it, thanks. main question: do we want to accept both `null` and absent keys? current SDK parsers usually expect the key to exist.

anya: i vote allow missing keys for backwards compat. we should include a migration note and an SDK shim example.

ben-ops: +1 to missing keys. also add a short note about Dedicated rollouts and fallback behavior (models that return string vs structured). add a telemetry flag `schema_migration_v2` for tracing.

ci-bot: build succeeded for PR #5821 (docs) ✅

docs-lead: action items: 
- sam: add python/js SDK snippets that handle missing/null tool outputs
- anya: add migration guide blurb + curl examples + JSON schema diff
- ben-ops: add routing/fallback notes for Dedicated + telemetry mention
Due: EOD Thu (self-assigned unless you reassign)

sam: quick sketch of python snippet i can drop in docs: 
```python
# robust parse for optional tool_output
resp = client.parse(response, schema)
tool = resp.get('tool_output')
if tool is None:
    # fallback to legacy parser
    legacy = resp.get('tool_text')
    # handle legacy path
else:
    # structured path
    ...
```

anya: i'll add a curl + expected responses example. planning to show three cases: structured object, null, and omitted key. will include a JSON Schema example using `oneOf` and adjust `required` accordingly.

sam: also adding a tiny test in tests/docs-schemas to cover the three cases so our lint/harness catches regressions.

docs-lead: perfect. once snippets/tests are pushed i'll do a final pass and merge. @sam @anya please drop links here when ready :rocket:

ben-ops: small gotcha — update the link in release notes for March patch: /release-notes/2026-03 and mention customers on Dedicated might need to pin older schema for a week during rollout.

sam: noted, will add a short paragraph.

ci-bot: deploy preview updated: https://deploy.preview.redwood-inference/docs/PR-5821

docs-lead: thanks all, i'll merge after the fixes and close this thread when PR is merged. :tada:
